problem.statement: Should Onsoo enter the US market in 2027, and by which route, to build toward $40M of US revenue by 2030 within $18M of peak cash, payback by 2030 and an 8% group margin floor?
problem.decision_maker: CEO, with the board, at the March 2027 board meeting
success_criteria: On the way to $40M of US revenue by 2030
Peak US cash need of $18M or less
US cash back to zero by end-2030
Group margin of 8% or more every year
problem.accuracy: Planning grade: built only on the briefing pack's inputs; no outside research
out_of_scope: Markets other than the US and Japan
Mass retail or DTC as the lead channel

one_day_answer.situation: US K-beauty facial skincare nearly doubled to $3.6B in four years, most of it sold on Amazon, and Onsoo's three-SKU Amazon test is selling
one_day_answer.complication: The board wants $40M by 2030 within tight cash, payback and margin limits, and management is split between an Amazon launch, 600 stores and Japan
one_day_answer.resolution: Launch on Amazon in 2027 with ad-cost and awareness gates, add stores only above 20% awareness, and restate $40M as a goal for after 2030
